Forme juridique de l'attributaire Le marché public sera conclu : – soit avec un opérateur économique unique ; 8/17 – soit avec un groupement d’opérateurs économiques conjoint ou solidaire. En cas de groupement conjoint, le mandataire sera solidaire, pour l'exécution du marché public, de chacun des membres du groupement, pour ses obligations contractuelles à l'égard de l’acheteur. La composition du groupement ne peut être modifiée entre la remise des offres et la date de signature du contrat. 2-6. ant indiquant qu'il ne tombe pas sous le coup d'une interdiction de soumissionner. Pour satisfaire aux obligations susmentionnées, le candidat qui envisage, dès le dépôt de son offre, de sous-traiter une partie de sa prestation, complètera utilement la déclaration de sous - traitance et joindra, pour chaque sous-traitant, l’ensemble des documents, attestations et renseignements réclamés aux candidats, tels que figurant au présent règlement de la consultation. La notification du marché public emporte acceptation du sous-traitant et agrément des conditions de paiement. Les prestations de services sont prouvées par des attestations du destinataire ou, à défaut, par une déclaration de l'opérateur économique ; • Une déclaration indiquant les effectifs moyens annuels du candidat et l'importance du personnel d'encadrement pendant les trois dernières années ; • Une description de l'outillage, du matériel et de l'équipement technique dont le candidat disposera pour la réalisation du marché public. references_experience.text: (MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. NOF2 was originally written by Naked Objects Group and supplied to the Department under an open-source licence.

Fixture scripts can also be used within the running application, facilitating manual/exploratory testing (discussed below). The Department also provides a number of other libraries to manage fixtures. The simple “fake data” library can be used in unit and other tests to select/generate a random value for use within a test. Integration tests should not hard-code any officer user Ids, instead the “officer leasing” library allows an unused user/officer account to be exclusively used, with logic to automatically check/reset the officer’s certificates for signed recorded actions. Production code should never use system time directly, instead it should be possible to “mock the clock” in tests. For the BOMi application the “Programmable Clock” service provides this capability. insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

This document contains technical criteria to be used in the programming, design, construction, measurement, verification and documentation of AOC facilities. This is a mandatory standard and is not a guidebook, textbook, handbook, training manual nor substitute for technical competence. It represents the AOC’s commitment to comply with the requirements of applicable law and widely accepted building codes and standards. This standard must be used in conjunction with the governing standards referenced in this document, as well as the building program for each project. If a conflict exists between these standards and a specific program and project requirements, contact Planning and Project Management for resolution. The design team must review compliance with the building program at each stage of the

throughout the planning, design, construction and occupancy of the project. Commissioning Guidelines for AOC Projects are contained in the policy statement of June 7, 2010. During the initial planning process, the AOC Project Team shall determine the purpose and role of commissioning. The purpose may be to ensure proper integration of a small renovation/rehabilitation into the Capitol 7 AOC Order 28-8, December 26, 2018 complex, or it may be related to a certification. It may range from simple, direct Owner commissioning by the AOC to an independent Commissioning Agent with a substantial budget. As a rule, if a project is designed by an Associate A/E, then commissioning will be performed by a third party hired by the AOC. Within the context of design for mechanical systems, commissioning plays a significant role. The designer of the mechanical system has these responsibilities: i. Develop and document the Program of Requirements (PoR.) ii. Develop a basis of design. Commissioning shall help ensure that mechanical systems operate properly as a holistic system. General: The main objectives of this section are to optimize building performance and minimize adverse effects on the environment. It is the intent of this section to achieve these goals through the following measures: i. Address planning, designing and construction of new buildings and renovations or alterations to existing buildings. ii. Increase cost savings through better energy, water and material management. iii. Reduce water supply constraints and preserve a critical natural resource. iv. Access tools to encourage energy efficiency improvements. v. Empower project teams to make more informed decisions. vi. G
